title: Bayreuth Festival opens with celebration and commemoration
facts: The Bayreuth Festival opened its 150th anniversary edition with a commemorative event titled 'Silenced Voices'.
German-Jewish author Michel Friedman delivered a keynote address at the Bayreuth Festival.
The 'Silenced Voices' event commemorated Jewish artists who worked at Bayreuth and were murdered or persecuted under the Nazi regime.
Katharina Wagner serves as the artistic director of the Bayreuth Festival.
The 2026 Bayreuth Festival featured the premiere of a new production of Richard Wagner's opera 'Rienzi'.
Memorial steles dedicated to persecuted Jewish artists were installed in the park surrounding the Bayreuth Festival grounds.
German Chancellor Friedrich Merz and former Chancellor Angela Merkel attended the 150th anniversary opening of the Bayreuth Festival.
Hungarian street artist Adam Heat created a large mural in the auditorium of the Festspielhaus.
The mural inside the Festspielhaus depicts King Ludwig II of Bavaria presenting Richard Wagner with a grail of money.
The Festspielhaus mural depicts conductors Wilhelm Furtwängler, Arturo Toscanini, Oksana Lyniv, and Nathalie Stutzmann.
The Festspielhaus mural includes a depiction of Adolf Hitler in elegant attire holding a glass.
Nike Wagner is the great-granddaughter of composer Richard Wagner.
Katharina Wagner publicly acknowledged her family's historical ties to the Nazi regime during her address.
Chancellor Friedrich Merz delivered an address discussing Richard Wagner's complex cultural legacy in Germany.
The opening celebrations of the Bayreuth Festival took place across two days starting on July 26, 2026.
